rca of the issue: Repro: call _broadcasts with malformed/sparse rows containing names=["null", ""] or similar string payloads. Current add() logic only checks non-empty strings and does not blacklist null-like tokens, so "null" is emitted as a channel name. In Sports Hub, that can pollute broadcaster lists and downstream matching. Mitigation: sanitize channel labels in _broadcasts by rejecting null-like literals (null/none/n-a/unknown as required), then keep existing casefold dedupe.
